resolution.title: [Nexthop] NH-4010 & NH-4020 Watchdog support
resolution.description:
#### Why I did it

Add watchdog support for NH-4010 and NH-4020.

Fixes https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/issues/24224

##### Work item tracking
- Microsoft ADO **(number only)**:

#### How I did it

1. Add watchdog's info to `pddf-device.json.j2`.
2. Implement the watchdog support in `platform/broadcom/sonic-platform-modules-nexthop/common/sonic_platform/...`

#### How to verify it

- arm the watchdog for 5 seconds caused the system to reboot:
```
$ sudo watchdogutil arm -s 5
# Then, reboot happened after 5 seconds
```
